description: Election Commission- Notice Under Section 66A (1) (a) Filling of a vacancy in the office of member of the Valikaman South West Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government authority (Valikamam South West Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for declaring a candidate elected to fill a vacancy caused by resignation, which falls under election-related matters and procedures.
